verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a desktop CPU, but nothing in the evidence pack covers virtualization: no hardware virtualization extensions, IOMMU, hypervisor compatibility, or Docker/container workflows. The listed OS support (RHEL, Ubuntu) and a report of good Linux developer performance are adjacent and do not show VM or container support.

support.subject: As a developer, VMs and containers run well on this silicon — documented virtualization support and mainstream hypervisor and Docker workflows
